failure_modes.mode: Ready schema marker survives file replacement or external migration
failure_modes.effect: Requests use an old file or missing schema
failure_modes.detection: File-replacement, schema-change and repeat-read SQL tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Check device/inode and SQLite schema_version; reopen replaced thread-local connections; serialize first initialization; explicit init_db remains unconditional

failure_modes.detection: Test reuse expires at read scope end and mutations/next request see new files
failure_modes.mitigation: Context-local, workspace/country-keyed read scopes only; no persistent cache and no executor/approval snapshot decorator

failure_modes.cause: Incomplete cache keys or browser races
failure_modes.effect: Wrong account data or jurisdiction displayed
failure_modes.detection: Nested/parallel owner isolation tests and navigation response tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Explicit root and country context in keys, scoped cleanup, render generation guards
Defensive copies of memoized read values

failure_modes.effect: Wrong queue counts or missing failures
failure_modes.detection: Compare full snapshot and progress counts/failures on populated fixtures
failure_modes.mitigation: Reuse existing candidates/exclusions and recent-run services; omit only static discovery planning and preview artifacts

failure_modes.mode: Polling recreates load or overwrites edits
failure_modes.cause: Full snapshot polling, overlapping requests or late responses
failure_modes.effect: Slow UI and lost control values
failure_modes.detection: Browser network counts and preserved controls across refresh/navigation
failure_modes.mitigation: Dedicated progress endpoint, single in-flight poll, request/render generation checks and debounced preview cancellation
